newsitem.title: QATAR: Stocks in Qatar spend week in a tight range.
newsitem.headline: Stocks in Qatar spend week in a tight range.

text.p: Activity at Qatar's unofficial stock market remained largely limited to insurance shares in the week to Thursday as trade in a handful of leading scripts was suspended ahead of their annual general meetings, brokers said.
Qatar National Bank, the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) and Qatar Shipping Company closed their share transfer books until after their shareholders' meetings scheduled over the next week.
But, the CBQ's 18-share index edged up fractionally to 129.01 points from 128.65 the previous week, thanks to a rise in six shares.
All three insurance firms posted a gain of five riyals each. Qatar Insurance advanced to 545, Al Khaleej Insurance to 245 and Qatar General Insurance to 635 riyals.
Al Ahli Bank of Qatar moved up five riyals to 260 and Qatar Cement gathered three riyals to 323. Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company advanced two riyals to 65.
